law: LAW-PTS-1 Profile Twin Sync: any update or command that changes the bot profile or the rizal.pw site profile must update both the ASSM profile card and the bio bot card (bio-source.json) in the same change.

command.console: R:\ console `edit` (ЯBOT profile command: edit · edit about · edit link · edit save · plain-English edits)

sync.site: rassm.js: every profile save (editSet / editSave) rewrites the live ASSM card in this browser (localStorage rassm.card) from the same fields
sync.bot: tools/profile-sync.js: rewrites both JSON files from one source; run after any bot/site profile change
